assertions.description: SecretBackend.AWS_SSM had no declaration on any platform's supported_secret_backends and was deleted from the enum; the renderer-facing module that owns it must not reintroduce it. Scoped to the module that defines the enum, not the wider deployment/config-store surface -- 'aws-ssm' also names an unrelated, surviving secretProvider value on ConfigSecretRef (datrix_common/config/config_store/models.py), which this spec's target deliberately excludes.
